TVS Star City Plus Likely Discontinued In India - De-Listed On Website

KS
By Kabir Sharma Chief Indian SUV & Mileage Editor • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • TVS Motor has had a trio of budget commuter motorcycles in its portfolio to rival the 110cc offerings from Hero MotoCorp, Honda and Bajaj.
  • These include the Star City Plus, Sport and Radeon (which was just updated in October 2026).
  • Now, TVS Motor’s commuter lineup seems to be reduced to just two offerings, down from three.
  • We’re talking about the potential discontinuation of the TVS Star City Plus from the Indian market.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Chief Indian SUV & Mileage Editor

Real-World Road Readiness & Practical Mileage Economics

In India's competitive SUV battlefield, certified ARAI figures should never be the sole basis for a purchase decision. Field reporting from Rushlane.com emphasizes that bumper-to-bumper city fuel economy, low-end torque for quick urban overtakes, and suspension suppleness over broken monsoon tarmac determine genuine daily driving satisfaction far more than high-spec dashboard gadgetry.

Big Picture: Consumer preference is overwhelmingly favoring vehicles that balance rugged rough-road capability with realistic fuel operating economics.

🔍 Technical Specifications & Regulatory Rules

Historically, November and December present the most lucrative window for automotive buyers in India. Dealerships face stringent fiscal targets and floor-plan interest costs on unsold stock. To prevent carrying inventory into the new calendar year—which triggers an immediate 1-year registration depreciation perception—manufacturers roll out cumulative benefits combining consumer cash discounts, corporate bonuses, and exchange top-ups.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions & Driver Rules

Why does real-world city mileage differ significantly from official ARAI figures?

ARAI mileage is certified under standardized laboratory conditions with steady-state cruising, no AC load, and empty passenger cabins. In heavy Indian urban stop-and-go traffic, real-world fuel economy typically drops by 25% to 40%.

Which SUV powertrain offers the lowest running cost for 1,500+ km monthly running?

For high monthly usage exceeding 1,500 km, factory-fitted CNG (₹2.80 - ₹3.40/km) and pure Electric SUVs (₹1.20 - ₹1.80/km) deliver substantial running-cost savings compared to Turbo-Petrol (₹7.50 - ₹10.00/km) and Diesel (₹6.50 - ₹8.50/km).

How does an automatic gearbox affect SUV fuel efficiency in dense city traffic?

While modern Torque Converters and DCTs are efficient on highways, in crawling city traffic, dual-clutch and torque converter gearboxes consume 10-15% more fuel compared to manuals or e-CVT strong hybrids.
